questions.q: She enjoys ___ TV in the evening.
questions.why: Після *enjoy* дієслово стоїть у формі *-ing* (герундій): *She enjoys watching TV.* *enjoy to watch* — типова помилка.

questions.q: I'm looking forward ___ you next week.
questions.why: У *look forward to* слово *to* — прийменник, а після прийменника — *-ing*: *looking forward to seeing you*. *to see* — помилка, бо це не інфінітив.
Після *admit* (визнати) — *-ing*: *He admitted taking the money.*
*It's no use* + *-ing* — «марно»: *It's no use crying.*
Після *mind* — *-ing*: *Would you mind opening the window?*

questions.q: I can't help ___ (laugh) when I see him.
questions.why: *can't help* + *-ing* — «не можу втриматися»: *I can't help laughing.*
*be worth* + *-ing* — «варто»: *The book is worth reading.*

answer: She suggested going to the cinema
questions.why: Після *suggest* — *-ing*: *She suggested going to the cinema.* *suggested to go* — помилка.
Герундій може бути підметом речення: *Reading books is my hobby.*
Після прийменника (*in*) — завжди *-ing*: *interested in learning*.
Після *mind* — *-ing*: *I don't mind working late.*
Після *avoid* — *-ing*: *She avoided looking at me.*
Після *finish* — *-ing*: *finished reading*.
*keep* + *-ing* — «постійно, раз у раз»: *He keeps forgetting my name.*
*feel like* + *-ing* — «хочеться»: *I feel like going out.*
*There's no point in* + *-ing* — «немає сенсу»: *There's no point in worrying.*
*be used to* + *-ing* — «звик»: *I'm used to getting up early.* *to* тут прийменник.
Після *deny* — *-ing*: *He denied breaking the window.*
Після *consider* — *-ing*: *Would you consider working abroad?*

answer: I can't stand waiting in queues
questions.why: *can't stand* + *-ing* — «терпіти не можу».
questions.hint: Терпіти не можу чекати в чергах.

questions.why: *give up* + *-ing* — «кинути, відмовитися».
*for* — прийменник, тому *-ing*: *Thank you for helping me.*

questions.q: I spent the whole weekend ___ the garage.
questions.why: *spend* + час + *-ing*: *I spent the weekend tidying the garage.*
Дозвілля й спорт: *go* + *-ing*: *go shopping, go swimming*.
*be busy* + *-ing*: *She's busy preparing for the exam.*
